author: sigma02345
quote: The anticipation for the PC version of GTA 6 is reaching an absolute peak among gamers worldwide. We absolutely need a GTA 6 PC port because playing this masterpiece at launch with unlocked framerates, ultra-wide monitor support, and advanced ray-tracing graphics is the ultimate gaming experience. PC players shouldn't have to wait years just to explore Leonida. Modding communities are also ready to expand the game’s lifespan for a decade. Rockstar Games must deliver a simultaneous or quick PC release to satisfy millions of dedicated desktop gamers who want to experience Grand Theft Auto VI at its absolute best performance.
